video_title: NBA Finals Game 2 Preview: Must Win For Wemby & Spurs

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's heavy involvement in Spurs team culture and traditions
quotes.excerpt: I was shocked by the level of Wembanyama's involvement. His fingerprints are all over it.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Have you go up there? That was his idea?

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: No, no, no. The founding of the group, even the name of the group. As I got to hang with them and talk to them, I was shocked by the level of Wembanyama's involvement. His fingerprints are all over it.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs players feel a strong civic duty to execute Wembanyama's vision
quotes.excerpt: They feel like this strong civic duty to live out his vision and to execute his vision.
quotes.quote: They feel like this strong civic duty to live out his vision and to execute his vision. It's a fun group of people, rowdy, but I heard not a single expletive from one of them.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's focus on creating a winning home court environment
quotes.excerpt: Wembanyama wants to be great. He wants to be the greatest of all time.
quotes.quote: Wembanyama wants to be great. He wants to be the greatest of all time. He wants to win as many championships as possible, and part of that is he wants to create the best possible home court environment. He will text Jordan Howenstine, their director of communications, and he'll text the group. His feedback going into the playoffs was, 'We've got to condense the chants, we've got to keep it simple, make sexy noise, not wasted noise,' because he wants it to be something that the whole crowd can catch on to.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's need for higher energy games to secure Spurs wins
quotes.excerpt: For them to be able to win for the next six, I think he's got to have at least two or three games where he has a different level of energy.
quotes.quote: For them to be able to win for the next six, I think he's got to have at least two or three games where he has a different level of energy. If he's looking like that, and again, we're talking about usually there's two days between these games. Because of the World Cup this year, the whole schedule is different, and so it's Wednesday and then Friday.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' historical challenge of overcoming a seven-game series fatigue
quotes.excerpt: Only one of them won the title. That's what the Knicks are trying to overcome.
quotes.quote: Thirteenth team to defeat the reigning champion in a seven-game series right before the NBA Finals. Among those previous 12, only one of them won the title. That's what the Knicks are trying to overcome. It does get back to, I think, a mental and physical fatigue.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's effectiveness against specific Spurs defenders
quotes.excerpt: He was 11 for 17 against Jalen and Penny, Devin Vassell and Carter Bryant.
quotes.quote: He was 11 for 17 against Jalen and Penny, Devin Vassell and Carter Bryant. Against everybody else who guarded him, he was 1 for 14. You could see when he got those specific matchups, especially against Stephon Castle and Devin Vassell, who aren't physical guys who he can use his strength to get some space against, he had a lot of success.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The necessity of increased minutes for Dylan Harper for Spurs success
quotes.excerpt: He has to play more than 27, 28 minutes. He's got to play 35 or 36 minutes.
quotes.quote: He has to play more than 27, 28 minutes. He's got to play 35 or 36 minutes. He should be getting some of these Harrison Barnes minutes. He should be getting some Devin Vassell minutes. He should be getting Carter Bryant minutes. They need him to play 36 minutes for them to have a chance, I think.
